channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: ADHD looks different in women and poses unique health risks
item.description: Once seen as a childhood condition mostly affecting boys, ADHD is now known to manifest differently in girls, leading to distinct health challenges.

item.title: Climate change is now threatening a pillar of childhood: summer break
item.description: As summer approaches, parents plan outdoor activities for young children, but extreme heat and wildfires are complicating those plans.

item.title: Children program robots to speak Indigenous languages
item.description: Many Native American languages are endangered. A 12-year-old in Michigan works with a mentor to preserve his language through robotics.

item.title: Displaced Lebanese use satellites to check on homes
item.description: Unable to return, some Lebanese displaced by Israel's invasion buy satellite images to see if their houses survived.
